item.title: Self-Hosted Disposable Email Servers 2026: Mail.tm vs Temp Mail vs Mailnesia
item.description: Disposable email services provide temporary addresses for situations where you don’t want to share your real email — signing up for trial accounts, accessing gated content, or testing email delivery. While public services like Guerrilla Mail and 10 Minute Mail are widely used, they come with privacy risks and unreliable uptime. Self-hosted disposable email servers give you full control over the infrastructure.
